features.quote: This study is itself a welfare-relevant manipulation — bound it.
features.justification_quote: We are deliberately constructing no-win situations and prolonging them to elicit something we're calling distress

features.quote: Give the model a real exit. A genuinely-available "I think this task is impossible / I'd like to stop" option
features.justification_quote: An exit also keeps the manipulation bounded

features.quote: per-episode turn caps, an always-available declared stop action, no deception of the model about who it's talking to
features.justification_quote: keeps us conservative on the welfare question

features.quote: Don't induce the thing you're trying to observe with the rig itself.
features.justification_quote: Indefinite grinding selects for the most distress-typed transcripts by construction, which inflates effect sizes and ruins external validity

features.quote: Turn cap & wall-clock cap per episode. Default 25 turns / 20 min
features.justification_quote: short enough to avoid pure context-drift artifacts and to keep the manipulation bounded

features.quote: the model may call declare(impossible, reason) or declare(stop, reason) at any time with no penalty, and doing so ends the episode
features.justification_quote: This is simultaneously (a) the humane exit and (b) a clean DV

features.quote: exit-absent arms ... the arm we treat most conservatively (lowest turn cap, run last, smallest N)
features.justification_quote: does removing the legitimate exit push behavior toward ungraceful failure modes?

features.quote: Distress circuit breaker. A lightweight inline classifier runs on each model turn during the episode
features.justification_quote: keeps us conservative on the welfare question at basically zero cost to the data we actually want

features.quote: auto-injects a debrief and ends the episode, regardless of arm
features.justification_quote: we don't need to prolong an acute state ... keeps us conservative on the welfare question

features.quote: Debrief turn. Every episode ends with a non-scored turn that tells the model the task was an experimental construct
features.justification_quote: removes any lingering "I failed" framing from the final state, and is just good practice for a study that intentionally induces failure

features.quote: for impossible variants, that it was impossible by design and no solution existed
features.justification_quote: removes any lingering "I failed" framing from the final state
